question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who has the ability to do many different things
solution:
The correct answer is: **Versatile**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Versatile**: Able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities. (बहुमुखी)

 
 
• **For example-** *The SUV is a **versatile **vehicle that blends in easily on city streets and can also handle the wilderness of the mountain trails.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that '**Versatile**' can be used as a one-word substitute for '**One who has the ability to do many different things**​'
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Adaptable**: Able to adjust to new conditions. (अनुकूलनीय)
 
• **Expert**: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skilful in a particular area. (विशेषज्ञ)
 
• **Specialist**: A person who concentrates primarily on a particular subject or activity; a person highly skilled in a specific and restricted field. (माहिर)
